parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule identifiers, names, and canonical SMILES for compounds appearing in the specified document. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to enforce availability of canonical SMILES. Filter by document CHEMBL1134488. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
